description: Defines data structures, constants, and enums for disk cache block file format used in Chromium, including index headers, cache entries, and LRU data.

classes.name: IndexHeader
classes.description: Header structure for the disk cache index file, containing metadata and control information.

classes.name: Index
classes.description: Represents the entire index file, including header and hash table.

classes.name: EntryStore
classes.description: Main structure for cache entries, storing key, hash, data pointers, and metadata.

classes.name: RankingsNode
classes.description: Stores LRU and modification info for cache entries.
